Here are the solutions with brief reasoning:

1. **[b38253e1-6890-442a-b951-96068e9d8b84-143692]**: The energy change when an electron is added to an isolated gaseous neutral atom is defined as electron affinity (ইলেকট্রন আসক্তি). **(B)**
2. **[b3b12d2a-6144-4e63-9cd4-f2dcfaf9634b-43867]**: $\cot^{-1}(3) = \tan^{-1}(1/3)$. Then $\tan^{-1}(1/2) + \tan^{-1}(1/3) = \tan^{-1}\left(\frac{1/2 + 1/3}{1 - 1/6}\right) = \tan^{-1}(1) = \pi/4$. Thus, $\sin(\pi/4) = 1/\sqrt{2}$. **(C)**
3. **[b3e22892-3afb-4fde-a58f-621cc2b4ed0a-137362]**: $w = \frac{M I t}{z F} = \frac{197 \times 2.50 \times 1800}{3 \times 96500} \approx 3.06\text{ g}$. **(D)**
4. **[b4d09688-21d6-4bca-9b5f-90230b1281c9-19616]**: Reinhard Genzel won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2020 along with Roger Penrose and Andrea Ghez. **(A)**
5. **[b76637b1-ac57-4517-acb9-b393f55567c8-86394]**: Hydrolith ($\text{CaH}_2$) reacts with water to release hydrogen gas and is widely used in portable hydrogen generation devices. **(C)**
6. **[b7c16856-e69a-46a4-b730-e75cd3a57d7e-28235]**: Since cohesive forces of mercury exceed adhesive forces with glass (contact angle $> 90^\circ$), capillary depression occurs and mercury falls inside the tube. **(C)**
7. **[b911c06f-8b3a-49c3-8ae5-b1c81d2b27ab-56566]**: Furan contains 4 $\pi$ electrons from two conjugated double bonds and 2 electrons from an oxygen lone pair participating in the aromatic system, totaling 6 delocalized $\pi$ electrons. **(B)**
8. **[b935c5f8-8023-45af-a6ff-b42de66f722e-76058]**: 'সভ্যতার সংকট' (Crisis in Civilization) is Rabindranath Tagore's famous essay written in 1941. **(A)**
9. **[b9a55ce7-cd40-44e8-bd86-e9247c2e3cda-143393]**: During the interphase stage, the nucleus is metabolically highly active, hence termed the metabolic nucleus. **(C)**
10. **[baf737d2-079d-47b5-a982-30aba341d89f-120791]**: The Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences was instituted by Sveriges Riksbank in 1968 and first awarded in 1969. **(A)**
11. **[bcc40a34-1744-4c94-ba13-ad3879bf63ea-43626]**: The defining characteristic separating a farce (প্রহসন) from a regular drama is satire/mockery (ব্যঙ্গবিদ্রূপ). **(A)**
12. **[be4a3522-18fa-465a-8700-c84222c180e2-41217]**: Lead becomes superconducting at $T_c \approx 7.2\text{ K}$, which equals $7.2 - 273.15 \approx -266^\circ\text{C}$. **(C)**
13. **[c087e32c-2993-4b42-a233-2355f664e5aa-64021]**: In HTML, superscript text (e.g. $p^2$) is rendered using the `<sup>` tag. **(B)**
14. **[c1bffdc8-5816-47ae-98af-17f1e121dd03-35387]**: Duplicate recessive epistasis (complementary genes) modifies the dihybrid phenotypic ratio to 9:7. **(B)**
15. **[c412b5db-8301-4709-8b13-3128e6ad966d-25201]**: Adsorption affinity increases with polarity and hydrogen bonding capacity: $-\text{COOH} > -\text{OH} > -\text{NH}_2 > -\text{CHO}$. **(A)**
